name: Xing-VL2.0-Decision

lineage.how_derived: 255-way linear readout replacing the LM head, non-causal full attention layers, trained with soft-label cross-entropy on static image-text decision data (vision tower frozen); a rename of RBDash-Decision-v0.2, nothing retrained

purpose: Typed decisions over a state with up to four images, one question and 1-255 options, returning a probability per option in one forward pass (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Card tag and LICENSE file present; text not read.

architecture.kind: Qwen3.5-style hybrid vision-language backbone with 255-way readout, last-token pooling, temperature 0.9766

pc-12gb.notes: 52.2 GB against a VRAM budget of 9.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-16gb.notes: 52.2 GB against a VRAM budget of 13.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-24gb.notes: 52.2 GB against a VRAM budget of 21.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-32gb.notes: 52.2 GB against a VRAM budget of 29.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

mac-16-24gb.notes: 52.2 GB against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 52.2 GB against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 52.2 GB against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

benchmarks.name: Decision Index 0.3 public vision suite (11 benchmarks, 12,210 rows)
benchmarks.variant: BF16, images capped at 1,638,400 px; public half only, not a leaderboard rank

strengths: A decision model reads a state (text, JSON, images) and a schema of typed questions and returns calibrated probabilities for every option in one forward pass; it does not generate text.
weaknesses: 52 GB, vision-only decisions on static images
perceptual overlap between training and evaluation images was not checked (card)
soft.maturity: 3.9k downloads, 14 likes; renamed from an earlier checkpoint

tona_fit.reason: Reported public vision index 77.78 is the highest vendor number among the 27B decision models, but it is the public half only and unverified; same class limits (pipeline step, 52 GB BF16).
